description: Datacircle lists all the GTM APIs. Our MCP server is open to anyone, with no key: add api.datacircle.dev/mcp to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. It answers from the sheet. list_apis lists the GTM APIs on it, and search_plans finds their plans by API, provider or price. Each plan comes with its score, and the best come first, as on the sheet.
